dedupe_keys.name: cal oes administrative regions and law and fire mutual aid regions california

description: This dataset maps the administrative regions of the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services and the law enforcement and fire mutual aid regions used to organise mutual aid between counties under the state emergency plan. Coverage is the whole state of California. It is a Cal OES feature layer republished on the California Open Data Portal, aimed at the general public and at Cal OES response personnel and partners. The layer is free to download as CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML, and is also available through an ArcGIS GeoServices REST API; the catalogue entry was refreshed in September 2026 and is updated irregularly. No licence is stated; Cal OES supplies the data as is and disclaims all warranties and liability. Caveats: region boundaries follow county lines and do not show individual resources, stations or agreements. Simulation uses: grouping counties into mutual aid regions when modelling how fire and law enforcement resources move between jurisdictions during large wildfires and earthquakes, and defining coordination zones in emergency response simulations for California. Related records: the NIFC wildland fire incident locations (data-nifc-wfigs-wildland-fire-incident-locations) give incidents to which such mutual aid responds.
